common.name: Name
common.emptyFiltered: Nothing found. Change or reset the filters.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Warehouse and sales of the CNC workshop
login.clientHint: Enter the phone number you gave when ordering
login.tabsHint: Ordered from us? Tap “I'm a customer”
login.enterPassHint: Enter the password the administrator gave you. Don't have one? Just ask us.
login.askAdminHint: The administrator issues your password. Please contact us and we'll give it to you.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.revenueReceived: Paid out of the period's revenue
dashboard.revenueSplitHint: Shares are by order value: an order on credit is included in full. Under each method — how much of these orders is already paid. The cash received in the period is on the “Revenue” tile (per the cash book).
dashboard.materialProfitHint: Sales minus what the material cost us (the purchase price of the lot it came from, as of the sale). Profit here is before rent, wages and other costs.
dashboard.cogsAside: For reference: cost of sales (not in “Expenses” — it comes before gross profit)
dashboard.clientMaterialsHint: All orders of the period except cancelled and returned lines — the same basis as “Material sold for”, and the table adds up to it. Orders with no name are gathered in the “No client” row.
dashboard.assetHint: At the purchase prices of the lots the material has not left yet.
dashboard.materialSalesHint: How much money each material brought in over the period. Cutting work on it stands beside as a separate figure: that is machine work, and it is not part of the bar.
dashboard.materialSalesEmpty: No material was sold in this period

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.rollHint: Measured in sq.m. Stock and cost come from intakes — the «Intake» button on the material row.
warehouse.wholesaleHint: The wholesale price kicks in automatically once the customer takes at least this many sheets. Leave the wholesale price empty or 0 if there is no wholesale.
warehouse.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? If it has sales, it will be hidden from the catalogue and the history kept.
warehouse.areaFromSize: Sheet area: {{value}} m² — derived from the size, no need to type it
warehouse.refEmpty: Empty so far — add the first value from the list above.
warehouse.refManagerHint: Renaming changes the label only — existing materials stay put. A hidden value disappears from the lists without breaking history. Only an unused value can be deleted.
warehouse.sheetAreaHint: The per-sqm price and the per-sheet price are independent: a cut piece usually costs more than the same area inside a whole sheet. An empty field is filled from the area ({{area}} sqm), a filled one is left alone.
warehouse.piecePriceHint: Set independently of the per-sqm price: the recalculation touches this field only while it is empty. Zero means a whole {{unit}} cannot be sold.
warehouse.formPieceHint: Counted in pieces: fasteners, glue, finished goods. Intake is entered as a quantity.
warehouse.piecePriceDiverged: The {{unit}} price works out at {{perSqm}} som/sqm. Compare it with the per-sqm price above: a cut piece usually costs more.
warehouse.rollWidthHint: A roll is cut across its full width, so it is sold by length. At the till the master enters the length only.
warehouse.rollWidthRequired: Required: without a width the roll cannot be saved or received — it is pre-filled at intake
warehouse.sheetSizeRequired: Required: the card cannot be saved without a sheet size — stock in sheets and the purchase price per sheet are both derived from it
warehouse.reconcileTitle: Material stock {{qty}} sq m, rolls total {{lots}} sq m — the difference belongs to no roll
warehouse.reconcileConfirm: “{{name}}”: material stock {{qty}} sq m, rolls total {{lots}} sq m. Set the stock to the rolls total? The difference goes to the stock journal as a line.
warehouse.rollStockByMeasure: Roll materials are checked by measuring each roll — Stock → “Measure”. They are not listed here.

pricing.title: Pricing & services
pricing.masterCommissionHint: The master's share of the cutting work value. Admin only; the calculated amount is shown in Finance under “Cutting by machine” (for reference, not part of profit).
pricing.servicesOnlyHint: Work rates and master %. Material prices live in the “Warehouse” section.
pricing.ratePerPm: Cutting rate, som per running m
pricing.ratePerPmHint: This machine's rate. 0 — the material's rate is used, as before the CNC/laser split.
pricing.machineHint: The “Cutting by machine” report in Finance is grouped by this.
pricing.noServices: No services yet. Add CNC and laser cutting — without a service there is nothing to cut with at the till.
pricing.engravingRateHint: Base price per sq m. At the till it can be changed for a specific order — by admin and storekeeper alike.
pricing.wasteRateHint: Base waste price, one per measure. At the till it can be changed for the individual sale — by the admin and the storekeeper alike.
pricing.minLineHint: A service line that comes out cheaper costs this minimum (like =MAX(500; calc) in Excel). Materials are exempt. 0 — off.
pricing.urgencyHint: Applied with the “Rush” toggle at checkout. 0 — the toggle is disabled.
pricing.rulesOrder: Order for each receipt line: catalogue price → minimum → + rush → − client discount → round up to a som. The receipt total is the sum of lines.
pricing.minLineServiceHint: Empty — the shared minimum from “Pricing rules”; 0 — no minimum for this service.
pricing.minLineBad: Minimum must be a number ≥ 0 or empty.

clients.title: Clients
clients.referralLocked: locked — an administrator can change it
clients.periodHint: Showing clients who ordered in the selected period. “Orders” is for that period; debt is current.
clients.passHint: Tell the client this password. They sign in with their phone number and it. Shown once — after that you can only issue a new one.
clients.reissuePassConfirm: Issue a new password? The old one will stop working.
clients.bulkPayHint: One sum settles the selected orders, oldest first.
clients.bulkPayAmountHint: Leave empty to settle the selected orders in full
clients.noDebtOrders: This client has no orders with debt
clients.backdatedHint: The payment will be recorded with a past date
clients.mergeHint: If one person was entered twice (the phone was typed in a different format), merge the cards: orders, debt, payments and referrals move here and the other card is deleted.
clients.mergeConfirm: The card “{{drop}}” will be deleted and its orders ({{orders}}) will move to “{{keep}}”. This cannot be undone. Continue?
clients.discountHint: Applied automatically at checkout. Only an administrator can set it.

checkout.title: New sale
checkout.tapToAdd: Tap a product to add it to the receipt
checkout.prepayHint: How much you took now. Empty — the whole order becomes debt.
checkout.cutHint: Turn on if the sheet needs cutting to size
checkout.runMetersHint: Cutting work is priced by it: rate × length
checkout.runMetersRequired: Enter the curve length — without it the shaped cut goes on the receipt for free
checkout.runMetersRequiredCart: “{{name}}”: no cut length — remove the line and add it again with the curve length
checkout.cutInfo: A piece is cut on the machine: price = material (area) + cutting work (running metre).
checkout.clientNamePlaceholder: Type a name — we'll find them
checkout.orderDateHint: Today. Set a past date if the order is being entered later.
checkout.orderDateBack: The order will be backdated — reports and stock will use this date.
checkout.changeHint: Stays owed to the client until handed over — visible in Receipts and on the client card.
checkout.modePieceNoPrice: This material has no per-sheet price — selling it whole is unavailable. Set it in Stock → «Edit».
checkout.modePieceHint: Sold as a whole {{unit}} at the per-piece price. Cutting can be added as a separate line.
checkout.modeCurveHint: Contour cut: the master enters the curve length. Price = material (area) + work (running m × rate).
checkout.modeSideHint: Straight cut: only one side — “Length” — counts as work. Price = material (area) + work (running m × rate).
checkout.modeSqmHint: Material by area only, no cutting work.
checkout.sideAuto: One side goes into the cut — “Length”: {{value}} running m
checkout.hasChange: Client has change from earlier orders: {{sum}} som
checkout.changeApplied: {{sum}} som will cover part of this order — {{left}} som left to pay.
checkout.changeKept: The change stays with the client — hand it out from Receipts.
checkout.hasDebt: Client owes for earlier orders: {{sum}} som
checkout.debtWithOrder: You take {{sum}} som — this order and the debt together.
checkout.debtKept: The debt stays with the client — collect it from Clients.
checkout.repeatEmpty: Nothing to repeat: none of this order's items are in the catalogue any more.
checkout.notEnough: Only {{left}} {{unit}} of «{{name}}» in stock — not enough for {{need}}
checkout.rollWidthFixed: Roll width {{width}} m — cut across the full width
checkout.rollLeftAfter: Roll left after the cut: {{n}} running m
checkout.backdatedWarn: This order will be recorded on {{date}}, not today
checkout.rollLeftAfterOne: Roll {{roll}} will have {{n}} running m left
checkout.usedWidthHint: How much width the client gets. Empty — all {{width}} m
checkout.usedWidthTooWide: Cannot exceed the roll width ({{width}} m)
checkout.rollNoPrice: No price per running metre set — ask the administrator
checkout.rollNoPriceAdmin: Set the price per running metre on the material card, or type it here
checkout.payDebtHowTo: Enter everything the client handed over in “Paying now”: the order is settled first, the rest pays off the debt, oldest orders first.
checkout.prepayWithDebtHint: Total received — for the order and the debt. Empty — the order goes on credit and the old debt stays.
checkout.payDebtNeedsAmount: Enter how much the client brought, or press “Full amount”: the debt is paid from that sum.
checkout.rateMissing: No cutting rate on the machine or the material — the work would go for free. Ask an administrator to set the rate in the catalogue.
checkout.rateMissingAdmin: No cutting rate on the machine or the material. Set it in “Prices & services” or on the material card — or type it here (0 = gift).
checkout.priceMissing: The material has no price in the catalogue — it cannot be sold for 0. Ask an administrator to set the price.
checkout.priceMissingAdmin: The material has no price in the catalogue. Set it on the material card — or type it here (0 = gift).
checkout.noCutService: There is no cutting service in the catalogue — the master's work will not reach the order. Ask an administrator to add one under “Prices & services”.
checkout.noCutServiceAdmin: There is no cutting service in the catalogue — the work will not reach the order, only the material will. Add one with “New service” under “Prices & services” (kind “Cutting”, machine, rate som/running m).
checkout.ownCutHint: The client brought their own material — nothing leaves the stock. One line goes to the receipt: cutting price × length cut.
checkout.ownCutNeedRate: Enter the cutting price — the client's material has no catalogue rate
checkout.ownCutCheckbox: Client's material — cutting only, nothing leaves the stock
checkout.engravingHint: Price per sq m of engraved area. Material is not part of the line: either it is the client's, or the sheet is sold as its own line.
checkout.engravingNotePh: e.g. logo on a plate, client's acrylic
checkout.engravingNeedRate: Enter the price per sq m — it is not set in the catalogue
checkout.debtNeedsClient: A credit order with no client — there will be nobody to collect from. Enter a name and phone.
checkout.wasteHint: Selling offcuts and rejects. Nothing leaves stock: this waste was already written off — as a reject at intake or as an offcut when cutting.
checkout.wasteNeedRate: Enter a price — waste is always negotiated
checkout.wasteNotePh: e.g. acrylic 3 mm offcuts, vinyl remnant
checkout.clearConfirm: Clear the receipt? Items and customer details will be reset.
checkout.warnCostUnknown: The cost of some items is unknown — the profit on this receipt is incomplete.
checkout.nameMismatch: This phone belongs to “{{name}}”; the name you entered did not match. The order was recorded for that customer.

block.needRunM: To add, enter the cutting length.
block.needRate: To add, enter the work rate.
block.needSize: To add, enter the width and length.
block.noCutService: No cutting service is set up — the item cannot be added.
block.needRollLen: To add, enter the length to cut off.
block.needRollPrice: The roll has no price per metre.
block.rollShort: The roll has fewer metres than needed.
block.rollTooWide: The item is wider than the roll.
block.needPiecePrice: The material has no price per piece.
block.needMatPrice: The material has no price per sq m.

checkout.urgentOff: No rush surcharge is set — an admin sets it in “Prices & services”.
checkout.discountFromClient: From the client card: {{n}} %. Empty — use it; 0 — remove it.
checkout.discountAdminHint: A discount for this order only. Empty — none.
checkout.warnBelowCost: “{{name}}”: the line sold for {{sum}} — below cost.
checkout.addRulesNote: Catalogue amount; the order's rules will apply: {{rules}}.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.rollbackTitle: Move the status back — if the button was pressed by mistake
receipts.payHint: Defaults to the full debt. You can accept a part.
receipts.confirmUnpay: Undo the payment on this receipt? It becomes «Unpaid» and the amount returns as debt.
receipts.editDateHint: Order date — revenue, profit and the stock sheet are all counted by it.
receipts.editItemsHint: Everything is editable: quantity, price, an extra line. Stock, cost and total recalculate themselves. If the whole order is wrong, deleting and re-entering it is simpler.
receipts.deleteConfirm: Delete receipt #{{number}} for {{total}}? Material returns to stock, payments are removed. This cannot be undone.
receipts.deleted: Receipt deleted, material returned to stock
receipts.changeHint: Empty — hand over all of it. Partial is fine: the till may be short of small notes again.
receipts.editItemsChangeHint: The total dropped below the money already taken — {{amount}} som becomes change owed to the client.
receipts.refundHint: Tick what the client returned. Material of these lines goes back to stock, money — as a cash outflow, no more than was paid on the receipt. Other lines stay as they are.
receipts.refundDebtHint: Part of the refund simply clears the order's debt — only the overpayment is paid back in cash.
receipts.refundEmpty: Nothing to refund — every line was already returned
receipts.repeatHint: Build the same order at the till — at today's prices

supply.sheetSizeMismatch: Sheet size {{got}} does not match the card ({{card}}). Sheets are sold by the card's area — check the size, otherwise part of a sheet that is not on the shelf will remain in stock.
supply.title: Supply & inventory
supply.areaHint: When the invoice is in square metres: no dimensions or counts needed. For a roll the area is converted to metres using the width from the card — otherwise the lot would not know its metres and could not be sold.
supply.noRollMaterials: No m²-based materials. Create one with the «Sheet / roll» checkbox in the catalogue (Warehouse).
supply.receivedOnHint: Can be back-dated — the lot queues for consumption by its real date.
supply.priceUnchanged: Empty — the purchase price stays as it is
supply.intakeFormHint: Form taken from the material — you can change it for this lot.
supply.adjustHint: Counted the stock and it differs from the system? Enter what is actually there. The difference is logged as an inventory adjustment.
supply.widthFromCard: Width {{width}} m — from the material card, frozen into this lot
supply.writeoffRollHint: Roll stock is written off per roll and in metres — at that roll's width and cost. The roll's remainder after the write-off is shown below.
supply.writeoffRollNone: This material has no rolls with stock left.
supply.paymentNeeded: Pick how it was paid — this decides whether money leaves the cash book.
supply.paymentHint: An expense of {{sum}} som will be written to the cash book.
supply.onCreditHint: The material arrived, the money did not leave — the debt appears in “Finance → Owed to suppliers”; pay it from there.

lotFix.title: Correct intake
lotFix.noLots: No lots — this material was received without lots.
lotFix.hint: A typo in the quantity, size or price of a received lot — even if it has already been sold from. Check what will change first, then confirm.
lotFix.widthFixed: Roll width cannot be changed after cutting
lotFix.closed: The month is closed — the correction will not go through:
lotFix.inferred: Older sales ({{n}}) were recalculated from the line cost: it exactly matches this lot's price.
lotFix.legacy: Older sales without lot records were not recalculated: {{n}}.
lotFix.notALoss: A correction is not a write-off: no loss or surplus appears in the P&L, cash does not change.

grid.title: Bulk catalogue entry
grid.hint: One row per material. Tab moves right, Enter moves down. Paste a block from Excel straight into a cell (Ctrl+V) — it spreads across rows and columns. A blank name is built from the fields; sheet area is computed from the size.
grid.name: Name
grid.hasErrors: Not saved: {{count}} rows have errors. Nothing was added — fix them and submit again.

finance.title: Financial report
finance.stockEndHint: End balance is computed automatically from stock value
finance.dailyHint: Each day follows the same P&L steps: revenue, cost and losses, expenses, depreciation, interest and tax. An expense paid in its own month counts on the payment day; fixed costs (rent, utilities) and depreciation are split evenly across the month's days. A refund counts on the day it is made. The total under the chart is the month's net profit, as in the “Summary”.
finance.dailyHoverHint: Hover a bar to see the day
finance.investmentsHint: A purchase from the capitalisation threshold is an asset: it reaches profit through depreciation. Cheaper ones are expensed at once.
finance.referralHint: Fixed amount per referred client. Shown in the client card; not added to expenses automatically.
finance.materialsHint: Total — transport and your own lines: this money leaves the cash box. Cost of goods and purchases above are turnover, not spending.
finance.materialsNeedSetup: Material cost is off for now: closing stock exceeds opening plus purchases. Fill in the balances under Stock → “Monthly stock”, or enter the opening stock by hand.
finance.periodHint: Every figure in the report is for the selected month.
finance.stockTableHint: Opening stock + deliveries − closing stock = sold. Stock on past dates is rolled back from today's stock.
finance.autoOverridden: Entered by hand; the system computed {{value}}
finance.autoPlaceholderHint: Empty means the system's figure is used. Type your own to override.
finance.cuttingVolume: {{pm}} running m cut · {{area}} sq.m of material
finance.cuttingHint: How much material went through each machine. Sq.m — the area of the cut piece, and this is the headline figure: it is about the volume of work. Running metres — the cut length, the sum is built from it (m × rate). These are different quantities and must not be added together. Cutting per material lives in the stock sheet.
finance.cuttingByUserHint: By whoever entered the order. There is no separate 'operator at the machine' field — if you need the actual cutter, it has to be picked at the till on every cut.
finance.allExpensesHint: The whole history in one list: when, what for and which report line it lands in. Manual expenses are added in the blocks above — click a row; material deliveries are counted automatically and are edited in Warehouse → Deliveries.
finance.dailySubtitle: Net profit of each day of the month — by the same steps as the P&L. Green is a day in profit, red a day at a loss.
finance.revenueHint: Revenue is the sum of all orders of the period by order date, minus refunds made in this period. Whether an order is paid does not change revenue: unpaid orders are shown separately as “on credit”.
finance.masterShare: Master's pay at {{pct}} % of cutting work: {{sum}}.
finance.masterShareHint: For reference — not part of profit; salaries are entered as records.
finance.cuttingUserShare: {{pm}} r.m of cut · work {{sum}} · master's share {{share}}
finance.investmentBlockHint: Machines, workshop repairs and improvements. A purchase from the capitalisation threshold is an asset: it reaches profit through depreciation from next month, while the cash leaves in full on the payment day. Cheaper ones are expensed at once.
finance.cogsRowHint: By lots at the moment of sale. This is working capital, not an expense: material bought — material sold.
finance.stockOpening: On hand at the start of the period
finance.stockReconcileHint: All time, not the selected period: stock value is only known as of now. Purchases − sold − written off = what should be on the shelves.
finance.investmentTileSub: reaches profit via depreciation from next month
finance.stockDiffHint: “Start + in − sold” differs from “on hand” by defects, shortages and recounts. Defects and shortages are an expense: they are in the P&L as “Material written off”.
finance.belowBlockHint: Loan interest reduces net profit. Tax payments are cash only: the tax itself (4% of revenue) is accrued automatically.
finance.dailyAria: Profit by day, {{month}} {{year}}: month total {{profit}}. Best day — {{best}}, worst day — {{worst}}.
finance.rulesHint: Already part of revenue: how much rush and line minimums added and how much discounts gave away from catalogue prices in the period.

expenses.subtitle: Cutter, transport, equipment, workshop upgrades and other variable costs.
expenses.cashHint: The expense is written to the cash book against this account.
expenses.periodHint: The expense goes to the P&L by this month and to the cash book by its date. Empty — the payment month. September rent paid on 5 October is “September”. Split a prepayment for several months into separate entries — one per month.
expenses.capexHint: Purchases from {{threshold}} are assets: they reach profit through equal monthly depreciation starting next month. Cheaper ones are expensed at once.
expenses.capexHintNoValue: Purchases from the capitalisation threshold are assets depreciated from next month; cheaper ones are expensed at once.
expenses.depreciateUntilHint: Broken or disposed — set the month: the remaining value is written off in it and depreciation stops. Past months stay unchanged.

myOrders.title: My orders
myOrders.howToPay: How do I pay the debt?
myOrders.payStep1: Wait until your order is ready (status “Ready for pickup”).
myOrders.payStep2: Pick up your order at the shop and pay the rest in cash.
myOrders.payNote: Online payment isn't available yet — we settle on pickup.
myOrders.changeHint: Pick it up next time, or we'll put it towards your next order.
myOrders.payStepNow: The order has already been handed over or needs no production: pay the rest in cash at the shop — no need to wait.

home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Key figures for the month and quick actions.
home.whatToDo: What do you want to do?
home.receiptsSub: Orders and who owes how much
home.note: Sales are made by an employee (log in as “I'm staff”). Customers check their own orders by phone.

financeGate.title: Section locked
financeGate.prompt: Enter the password to open Finance and Detailed analytics.

fixed.subtitle: Rent, utilities, internet and the rest — dated records.

salary.subtitle: Who was paid, how much and when.

kinds.name: Name
kinds.block: Which block to show it in
kinds.builtinHint: Built-in type: name and order can change, the block cannot.
kinds.confirmDelete: Delete this expense type? If it has entries it will be hidden instead, and the entries kept.
kinds.hidden: Type hidden, its entries were kept
kinds.openHint: Open the spending for this type
kinds.investmentHint: Purchase: from the capitalisation threshold it is an asset reaching profit through depreciation; cheaper ones are expensed at once.
kinds.purchaseIsAuto: Purchases are counted automatically from stock intake. Pay suppliers in “Owed to suppliers”; record off-stock purchases as a variable expense.
kinds.opexHint: Operating expense: reduces the profit of the month it belongs to.

stockSheet.title: Stock by material
stockSheet.hint: Opening stock carries over from last month's closing automatically — enter it once, in the month you start from. Then: opening + received − sold = closing. Any cell can be corrected by hand.
stockSheet.needMonth: Pick a specific month to enter opening stock.
stockSheet.linkFromFinance: Open the stock sheet by material
stockSheet.manualCell: Entered by hand — overrides the computed value
stockSheet.carriedCell: Carried over from last month's closing

print.title: Print order
print.actIntro: We, the undersigned, have drawn up this statement confirming that the state of mutual settlements according to the accounting records is as follows:
print.actRefundPaid: Paid back in cash on refund No. {{n}}
print.actOwes: Client's debt at the end of the period: {{sum}} som
print.actClear: No debt at the end of the period
print.actEmpty: No transactions in the selected period
print.roundedNote: Line amounts are rounded up to a whole som.
print.rulesNote: Prices include the order's rules: {{rules}}. At catalogue prices — {{sum}} som.

supplies.hint: A delivery is entered as ONE document: the note number, the supplier and all lines at once. The system total stands next to the paper total — you see at once whether they match.
supplies.diffFull: Differs from the note by {{sum}}. Check the line amounts.
supplies.needLines: Fill in at least one line: material and amount
supplies.cancelConfirm: Cancel note {{n}}? The material will be removed from stock. If some of it was already cut, the system will refuse.
supplies.editHint: An administrator fixes a typo in a line's quantity or price with “Correct intake” — cost of sales, stock and the supplier debt are recalculated. Wrong material — cancel the note and enter it again.
supplies.linesIncomplete: Rows {{rows}} are incomplete — the document is not posted until every started row has a material and a total (0 if free).
supplies.widthDiffers: The material card says roll width {{width}} m — check it is not a typo
supplies.dateMoved: Date moved — lots and stock entries followed it

waste.title: Waste (defect)
waste.hint: Defects are written off with the same measures as intake: sheets by size and count, rolls by metres from a roll, pieces by quantity, or straight by area. The cost of what was thrown away goes to the stock journal.
waste.done: Waste recorded — the material has left the stock
waste.needLines: Fill in at least one line: material and size or quantity
waste.linesIncomplete: Lines {{rows}} do not pass — the reason is written under each of them.

cash.title: Cash and bank
cash.hint: How much money there is now. Payments, change, refunds, Finance expenses and supplier payments are recorded automatically — enter by hand only what the system cannot know: owner money, loans, transfers between till and bank, the opening balance.
cash.needAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero
cash.manualHint: Order payments, change, refunds and expenses from Finance do not need to be entered here — they reach the cash book on their own.
cash.countHint: Count the money and enter the result. The system records the difference as a separate line — like a stock count — so a shortage is not lost.
cash.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry from the cash book?
cash.expensesViaFinance: Enter rent, salaries and other expenses in Finance — from there they reach both the P&L and this cash book.
cash.hint_LOAN_OUT: Loan principal only. Enter interest in Finance as “Loan interest” — it reduces profit.
cash.hint_TRANSFER: Money moved between your own accounts — enter both halves: an outflow from one and an inflow to the other.
cash.hint_OPENING: Money that was in the till or on the account before the system started tracking it. Not income and not a cash movement — shown outside the flow.

period.title: Period lock
period.hint: After closing, the orders, payments, expenses, cash entries and deliveries of this period become read-only. The report for a closed month no longer changes by itself. A refund on an order from a closed month is recorded today and leaves the closed month untouched.
period.open: Period is open — anything can be edited retroactively.
period.opened: Period opened — retroactive edits are allowed again

recipes.hint: What the service consumes on top of the main material: glue, fasteners, solvent. It is deducted from stock automatically on sale and counts into the line's cost.
recipes.modePerSqmHint: Counted from the piece area: 0.05 per sq.m on a 0.5 sq.m piece is 0.025, no matter how many metres are cut.
recipes.modeFixedHint: The same amount for every service line, whatever the size.
recipes.empty: No consumables — the service deducts nothing beyond the material.
recipes.confirmDelete: Remove “{{name}}” from the card? It will no longer be deducted.

suppliersDebt.title: Owed to suppliers
suppliersDebt.hint: Delivery notes and intakes on credit — with what exactly arrived and how much is already paid. A payment goes out of cash or bank on the payment date.
suppliersDebt.tooMuch: You cannot pay more than is owed.
suppliersDebt.openHint: Open the documents behind the debt
suppliersDebt.docsCount: Documents on credit: {{n}} — click to see what for

statements.pnlHint: Earnings by month on an accrual basis: revenue by order day (refund — by refund day), cost of sales and material losses, expenses by the month they belong to, depreciation, interest and tax on revenue. Each month equals the profit in the month's “Summary”.
statements.cashFlowHint: Real money by month — per the cash book (cash and bank): what came in, what went out and on what. Opening + flow + outside the flow = closing. Transfers between till and bank do not change the total and are not part of the flow.
statements.lossesUnknown: {{n}} more write-offs have no cost recorded (before 04.09) — their money is not in the line.
statements.bridgeHint: From the month's net profit to the net cash flow. The sign is the effect on cash: plus — more cash than profit (e.g. clients paid old debts), minus — less (e.g. an order on credit or a stock purchase). The bottom line is the same flow as in the cash flow statement. “Unexplained” must be 0.
statements.currencyNote: All amounts are in som, by calendar month.
statements.notBalanced: Balances do not match the cash book — please tell the developer.
statements.unmatchedWarn: Transfers of the month do not sum to zero: only one half of a transfer was entered (or a transfer spans two months). Check the cash book.

assetTax.title: Depreciation and tax
assetTax.hint: Changing these settings does not touch purchases already entered: each one keeps its own decision and life.
assetTax.thresholdHint: An “Investments” purchase from this amount is an asset with depreciation; cheaper ones are expensed at once
assetTax.leaseUntilHint: Workshop improvements are depreciated no longer than the lease. Empty — 60 months

taxRates.title: Tax rate on revenue
taxRates.hint: A new rate applies from its month and does not recalculate the past. Closed months cannot be changed.
taxRates.empty: No rate set — no tax is accrued.
taxRates.needBoth: Enter the month and the rate
taxRates.confirmDelete: Delete the rate from {{month}}? Tax for those months will use the previous rate.

terms.revenue: Orders placed in the period — by order day, including orders on credit and prepaid ones. A refund reduces revenue on the day it is made. Unpaid online invoices are not included.
terms.revenueTile: Orders placed this month (including on credit and prepaid).
terms.cogs: What the sold material and service consumables cost us — at the purchase price of the lots at the moment of sale.
terms.losses: Defects and shortages at cost: material left the warehouse and will bring no money. Part of cost of sales, before gross profit.
terms.gross: Gross profit — revenue minus cost of sales and material losses. What is left for rent, salaries and everything else.
terms.opex: Operating expenses — rent, salaries, utilities, transport, consumables and so on. Counted by the month they belong to (“for which month”), not by the payment day.
terms.opex_cash_manual: Expenses entered directly in the cash book before 27.09.2026 — they have no “for which month”, so they count on the payment day.
terms.cash_count: Cash count: a shortage reduces profit, a surplus increases it.
terms.ebitda: EBITDA — profit from the workshop's work before depreciation, loan interest and tax. Handy for comparing months.
terms.depreciation: Depreciation — the price of machines and workshop repairs spread evenly over their useful life. Purchases below the capitalisation threshold are expensed at once.
terms.disposal: A machine broke or was disposed of: its remaining value is written off at once in that month.
terms.operating: Operating profit — EBITDA minus depreciation. What the workshop earned by its work.
terms.interest: Loan interest — the price of borrowed money. The loan principal itself is not an expense: it is in the cash flow, financing activities.
terms.tax: Tax on revenue at the current rate (4% from October 2026). Accrued automatically; paying it is cash only and does not reduce profit a second time.
terms.net: Net profit — what remains after all expenses, depreciation, interest and tax.
terms.capex: Capital expenditure — equipment and workshop improvements from the threshold (20,000 som). Cash leaves at once, while the price reaches profit in parts — through depreciation.
terms.margin: Margin — the share of revenue left as profit, in percent.
terms.cash_opening: Money in the till and on the account on the first day of the month.
terms.cash_operating: Money from the main work: client payments, refunds, supplier payments, expenses, interest, tax.
terms.cash_investing: Money spent on machines and workshop improvements (purchases from the threshold).
terms.cash_financing: Owner money and loans: owner put in or took out, a loan received or repaid.
terms.cash_outside: Does not change the total: transfers between till and bank and the opening balance. Not part of the flow.
terms.net_cash_flow: Net cash flow — how much money grew or shrank over the period (without transfers between own accounts).
terms.cash_closing: Money in the till and on the account at the end of the period — per the cash book.
terms.bridge: Profit and cash differ: an order on credit is revenue without cash, a machine is cash without expense. The reconciliation shows exactly why.
terms.bridge_net_profit: Net profit of the period from the P&L — the starting point.
terms.bridge_non_cash: Depreciation reduced profit but took no cash this month — the cash left earlier, at purchase.
terms.bridge_receivables: Orders on credit: revenue without cash yet. When clients pay old debts it works the other way.
terms.bridge_client_money: Change not handed out and prepayments: client money is with us but is not revenue yet.
terms.bridge_inventory: Material bought — cash left, but it becomes an expense only when sold. Stock growth absorbs cash.
terms.bridge_payables: Material arrived but the supplier is not paid yet — the cash is still with us. Purchases before 19.09.2026 were paid outside the cash book and show here.
terms.bridge_accrued: An expense belongs to this month but was paid later (or a previous month's expense was paid now).
terms.bridge_tax_payable: Tax accrued but not paid yet — the cash is still with us.
terms.bridge_capex: Machines and workshop improvements: cash left in full, the price reaches profit in parts.
terms.bridge_financing: Owner contributions and withdrawals, loans — money neither earned nor spent on work.
terms.bridge_other: Cash book entries with the “Other” article — they do not affect profit.
terms.bridge_unexplained: Must be 0. If not, the data contradicts itself and needs checking.
